sections.content_text: Section 224 - Entitlement of Refund (1) Where any person satisfies the Deputy Commissioner of Taxes that the amount of tax paid by him or on his behalf in any year or the amount of tax deemed to have been paid by him or on his behalf in that year exceeds the amount of tax claimed from him under this Act, in that case he shall be entitled to refund of the excess amount paid. (2) Where the income of any person is included in the total income of any other person under any provision of this Act, such other person shall be entitled to refund under this Act in respect of such income alone.
